symptom.reading: prefill runs at roughly decode speed per prompt token, which is what token-at-a-time looks like

llama_cpp_same_file.reading: a properly batched prefill is about 18x faster than its own decode

lever_measured.note: the lever exists, is parity-tested and is default-off, but it buys 1.15x here, not the recorded 2.1-2.3x

why_the_lever_is_small: it batches 8 prompt tokens per forward, so it amortizes one weight read across 8 tokens instead of 512

blocker_chain.reason: two float4 partial accumulators; shmem tile is B*256 floats, 8 KB at B=8
blocker_chain.error_when_exceeded: kernel: gemm_q4_k_m_batched_v3w_pinned_tcb supports batch in 1..=8; got 32
blocker_chain.verdict: THE ACTUAL WALL. Not a constant, not the arena, and not memory: 75 GB was free throughout.

blocker_chain.reason: a fused swiglu+add+rmsnorm+ffn kernel with its own shmem layout and accumulators
blocker_chain.verdict: the next wall, and it is a harder kernel than the GEMM because it fuses four operations

k6_target: a tiled GEMM prefill kernel. Prefill is matrix-matrix work being run as a batch-8 GEMV, which is why it lands near decode speed while llama.cpp lands 18x below its own decode.

size_of_the_prize.note: the 20.8x prefill gap is the single largest measured number in this campaign and the least worked on

what_changed_in_code: the two constants became one env var, clamped to the kernel's real ceiling and commented with it, so the chain is discoverable instead of being rediscovered by a sweep that silently does nothing

k6_implementation.kernel: gemm_q4_k_m_batched_v3w_mma_n32, four simdgroup_matrix accumulators against one resident weight tile
k6_implementation.shmem: 1536 floats (6 KB), independent of batch, against a 32 KB limit
k6_implementation.correctness: agrees with v3w at B in {1,2,4,8} across three shapes; at B in {9,16,32} every column matches the single-token v3w result; B=33 refused

scope_correction.what_i_expected: one kernel capped the prefill batch
scope_correction.what_is_true: the B=8 assumption is spread across the whole prefill path, not concentrated in one kernel

sites_found.gemm_q4_k_m_batched_v3w: lifted, by routing b>8 to the new n32 kernel
sites_found.v3w_call_sites_in_qwen_dense: 7090, 7102, 7456, 7786, 8076 in the prefill path, plus 8251, 8402, 8619 elsewhere

scope_correction.consequence: K6 is a kernel family, not a kernel. The N-tiling is proven on the GEMM, which was the hard and uncertain part, but B>8 end to end additionally needs the fused FFN kernel widened and the remaining call sites routed.

measured_this_pass.b16_and_b32: REFUSED by the fused FFN kernel, so unmeasured

default_path_after_k6.reading: within trial spread; the shipped path is unchanged, which is the intent while the default stays 8
